articles.headline: Lithuania foils arson attack on Starlink equipment, suspects Russian involvement
articles.excerpt: The attackers attempted to set fire to satellite antennas and a control unit, Prime Minister Mindaugas Sinkevicius said.

articles.headline: Russian drones hit western Ukraine as nationwide attacks kill 10, injure 73
articles.excerpt: Russian strikes hit 20 locations, while falling debris was reported at four other sites.

articles.headline: Zelensky reveals how many Russian attacks have followed Trump's energy ceasefire
articles.excerpt: "Tens of thousands of families are without power," President Volodymyr Zelensky said.

articles.headline: Hungary ready to allow Ukrainian grain transit to Western Europe, prime minister says
articles.excerpt: "If it just passes through the country, then obviously there is no obstacle to it," Hungarian Prime Minister Peter Magyar said.

articles.headline: General Staff: Russia has lost 1,565,060 troops in Ukraine since Feb. 24, 2022
articles.excerpt: The number includes 2,090 casualties that Russian forces suffered over the past day.
